title: Dialogue text store (one file per scenario)
description: Stable id -> string. Variables are kept as $-placeholders and substituted at render time from GameState. This file is the localization seam: feed it into Godot's CSV/PO translation pipeline.

^snr[0-6]/[0-9]+$.description: Decoded line. May contain control/variable placeholders: \n = newline; $n player name; $s dynamic name; $rNN port/region ref; $dNN number slot.
